name: Federal Republic of Central America
facts: Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua and Costa Rica

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue, with the coat of arms in the center: a triangle showing five volcanoes between two seas under a rainbow and a red cap of liberty, inside a ring reading "República Federal de Centro América".
flag.symbolism: The blue stripes stand for the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea and the white for the land between them; the five volcanoes represent the five member states.

hook: The Central American federation flew blue-white-blue with five volcanoes in a triangle; Nicaragua and El Salvador still use almost the same triangle, and Honduras turned the five states into five stars.
trivia: All five of its former member states still have blue and white in their flags.
The federation fell apart as its states left one by one between 1838 and 1841.
